title: Barcelona midfielder determined to stay and fight for place as agent meets Deco
tweet: Olmo and Deco met in Barcelona yesterday to confirm the midfielder’s intent to stay. No talks are underway and Barça would need a significant offer before a sale is considered. The player is focused on earning a larger role under Flick, so a departure remains unlikely.

title: Confirmed: Barcelona squad list to face Real Betis – key duo return
tweet: Barça’s squad list for tomorrow’s Betis trip now includes Raphinha and Frenkie de Jong, both cleared after recent injuries. The return adds depth, especially for the forthcoming PSG Champions League match, though neither is slated to start. The real test will be how Flick integrates them into the lineup.

title: Former Barcelona director reflects on the signings of Pedri and Abde: ‘Generated a lot of criticism’
tweet: Planes explained that the €5 million fee for Pedri, a player yet to play La Liga, sparked criticism because Barça already had a strong La Masia pipeline; as things stand the move is now judged one of the club’s best transfer operations.

title: Three talking points ahead of Real Betis vs Barcelona | La Liga MD 9
tweet:
Betis’ 19‑point haul and six‑of‑eight win record make them the most dangerous opponent before PSG and Real Madrid.  
Raphinha’s return adds a threat from wide, but Flick will likely keep him off the bench to protect the rhythm.  
A win will give Barça a morale lift before the two‑game stretch; a loss could expose depth issues that must be addressed quickly.

title: Unbeaten for nearly two decades: Barcelona’s tremendous away record vs Real Betis
tweet: Barça have not lost at Betis since 2008, tallying 11 wins, 4 draws and a 39‑21 goal difference. The record gives them a psychological edge in Seville, but the fixture still tests squad depth after a 5‑3 win under Flick last season. A win would extend both the historic run and the record‑setting start to the campaign.
